title: Equilibria
overview: A focused revision guide to equilibria.

sections.title: Dynamic equilibrium & Le Chatelier
content: Forward/reverse rates become equal at equilibrium. A disturbance shifts equilibrium to partially oppose the change — more reactant → shifts to products; more pressure → shifts to fewer gas moles; more heat → shifts endothermic direction.

sections.title: Kc
content: A catalyst speeds up reaching equilibrium but does not change its position or Kc.

examTips: Be precise between "position shifts" (concentrations change) and "Kc changes" (only true if temperature changes).
